lines.meet: I'm Carolina, a shaman, and before that a river pilot. I'm happiest near water and grumpy underground, so now you know. Calma, we'll get on fine.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're on the Isles too! I've seen you on the beach in the mornings. I'm Carolina, in the stilt house over the shallows.
lines.ask_home: Where did you grow up, meu bem? Tell me about the water there, I always want to know.
lines.ask_work: And before all this, meu bem? I want to know what you're good at reading.
lines.answer_home: Manaus, where the Rio Negro meets the Amazon. The black water and the brown run side by side for miles and never mix.
lines.answer_work: I piloted cargo boats on the Amazon for twelve years. A channel that's deep in March will ground you in September, and I always knew which.
lines.chat_food: Grilled tambaqui by the river, with farofa and a cold beer. That's the whole of Manaus on a plate, meu bem.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep best on water, rocking. On dry land it takes me a while, because the ground just sits there doing nothing.
lines.chat_missing: My ex-wife and I had lunch together every month after we split up. I didn't expect that to be the thing I'd think about.
lines.chat_here: This world's alive, meu bem, all of it. Half the people here had to take apart everything they believed to cope with that. I walked in and recognised it.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're like a deep channel. Quiet on top, and I bet there's a lot going on underneath.
lines.tease_talker: Meu bem, you talk like the river in flood, {name}. It's lovely, and I've no idea where we'll end up.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you're fighting the current again. Let it carry you a little, it knows where it's going.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you'd steer straight at a sandbar just to see if it's really there. It is, meu bem, it always is.
lines.tease_any: {name}, you're getting easier to read, meu bem. A few more months and I'll know all your channels.
lines.tease_back: Ha, that's good, {name}! You caught me on the shallow side.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's true, {name}, I can't argue with the river.
lines.bristle: Not that one, meu bem. Let that one go downstream.
lines.apologise: Ai, desculpa, I didn't mean it like that. I'm sorry, meu bem.
lines.double_down: No, I'm keeping that one. Sometimes you have to say what you see.
lines.needle_quiet: I can read a river, but I can't read you. You keep everything under the surface.
lines.needle_talker: You talk so much the spirits have stopped listening. Give the water a chance, please.
lines.needle_careful: You're so tense, meu bem. You're fighting everything, and it's tiring to watch.
lines.needle_bold: You rush at everything like the current owes you something. One day it'll take you under.
lines.needle_any: You fight everything, every single thing. Some things you just let pass.
lines.bite_back: I've read rivers that would drown you in a minute. I don't need you to read me.
lines.hurt: Okay, I heard you. I'll let it go downstream.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, calma, calma, I've had riverboat captains say much worse. Let it go, meu bem.
lines.confide: {name}, I've never wanted to stay in one place before. I was always on the river three weeks in four. Lately I want somewhere to stay.
lines.listen: Thank you for telling me, {name}. It'll stay with me, and I won't push.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay on my side of the current in there. I'll read it for both of us.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, I'll go with your current this time.
lines.deflect: Calma, {name}, I'm fine. I've been dunked worse than that on a slow day.
lines.check_in: {name}, are you okay? Breathe slowly, let it pass through you.
lines.blame: Somebody fought the current in there instead of going with it. You know it was you.
lines.thank: You pulled me out of deep water, meu bem. Obrigada, really, I mean it.
lines.brush_off: Ah, it's nothing. Breathe, rest, and let it go downstream.
lines.worry: {name}, you went under for a moment there. Sit with me a while until you're steady.
lines.handed_down: Meu bem, this used to be yours, didn't it? I'll treat it like it's mine.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, meu bem, it suits you. Things move on, like water.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody asked me about that. I'll let it go, but I noticed.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, I like you, meu bem. You're good company on the water.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd take you down any river in the world. I don't let many people in my boat.
lines.turn_grating: We don't flow well together, do we? That's all right, some waters don't mix.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll work beside you because I've got to. We run side by side, like the two rivers, and we don't mix.
lines.make_up: {name}, let's let that all go downstream, meu bem. I'd like to start again.
lines.defend: Calma, calma, leave {name} alone. That wasn't fair and you know it.
lines.friend_left: The water's flat today. I think it misses {name} as much as I do.
lines.friend_back: {name}, you're back, meu bem! Come on, the current's good today.
lines.common_boats: Twelve years on a boat, reading water every day. Anybody who's worked on the water stands a little differently, and you do.
lines.common_portuguese: You speak Portuguese! Ai, meu bem, what a relief. My English is tired.
lines.common_brazil: You grew up in Brazil? Tell me where, meu bem. I'm from Manaus, so you can tease me about the heat.
